back_translation: Find what has been written in the journal

english: Find the note, photo or field observation you need again.
xhosa_before: Fumana inqaku, ifoto okanye into oyibonileyo entsimini oyifunayo kwakhona.
back_translation: Find the note, photo or thing you saw in the field that you want again.

english: Search journal titles, notes, crops and beds
xhosa_before: Khangela izihloko, amanqaku, izityalo namabhedi kwincwadi yemihla
back_translation: Search titles, notes, crops and beds in the journal

english: Both dates are included. Leave either date empty for an open range.
xhosa_before: Yomibini imihla iyabandakanywa. Shiya nawuphi na umhla ungazaliswanga ukuze ufumane uluhlu olungenamida.
back_translation: Both dates are included. Leave any date unfilled to get a range without a limit.

note: "Ibhedi okanye isiza" is bed or site; plot is nearer "isiza" alone. Understandable.

english: Keep a copy of this {n} entry
back_translation: Keep a copy of the entries numbering {n}

english: Keep a copy of these {n} entries
back_translation: Keep a copy of the entries numbering {n}

english: Works offline. Only the matching entries are included. You can include saved photo thumbnails in the printable copy.
xhosa_before: Isebenza ungekho kwi-intanethi. Kubandakanywa kuphela okubhaliweyo okuhambelanayo. Ungabandakanya iifoto ezincinci ezigciniweyo kwikopi yokushicilela.
back_translation: Works when you are not on the internet. Only the matching entries are included. You can include small saved photos in the printable copy.

english: Leave this on to include saved photo thumbnails. Turn it off for a smaller copy with notes only.
xhosa_before: Shiya oku kuvuliwe ukuze ubandakanye iifoto ezincinci ezigciniweyo. Kuvale ukuze ufumane ikopi encinci enamanqaku kuphela.
back_translation: Leave this open to include small saved photos. Close it to get a small copy with notes only.

english: These notes stay on this device. Keep a copy before clearing browser storage or changing phones.
xhosa_before: La manqaku asala kule divayisi. Gcina ikopi ngaphambi kokucima indawo yokugcina yesikhangeli okanye ukutshintsha iifowuni.
back_translation: These notes remain on this device. Keep a copy before clearing the browser's storage place or changing phones.

english: CSV downloaded. It contains the entries shown here.
xhosa_before: I-CSV ikhutshelwe. Iqulathe okubhaliweyo okubonisiweyo apha.
back_translation: The CSV has been downloaded. It contains the entries shown here.

english: Printable copy downloaded. Open the HTML file, then choose Print or Save as PDF in your browser.
xhosa_before: Ikopi yokushicilela ikhutshelwe. Vula ifayile ye-HTML, uze ukhethe ukushicilela okanye ukugcina njenge-PDF kwisikhangeli sakho.
back_translation: The printable copy has been downloaded. Open the HTML file, then choose to print or save as PDF in your browser.

english: The file could not be prepared. Your notes are unchanged. Try again.
xhosa_before: Ifayile ayikwazanga ukulungiswa. Amanqaku akho awatshintshanga. Zama kwakhona.
back_translation: The file could not be prepared. Your notes have not changed. Try again.

english: Try another word, a wider date range, or clear the filters. Your saved notes are still here.
xhosa_before: Zama elinye igama, uluhlu lwemihla olubanzi, okanye ucime izihluzi. Amanqaku akho agciniweyo asekhona.
back_translation: Try another word, a wider range of dates, or clear the filters. Your saved notes are still there.

english: The start date must be on or before the end date.
xhosa_before: Umhla wokuqala kufuneka ube ngaphambi komhla wokugqibela okanye ufane nawo.
back_translation: The first date must be before the last date or the same as it.
Show the journal history of the bed: {value}
Show the journal history of the crop: {value}

english: Open a photo or compare two dates. These are the pictures saved with your notes.
xhosa_before: Vula ifoto okanye uthelekise imihla emibini. Ezi ziifoto ezigcinwe namanqaku akho.
back_translation: Open a photo or compare two dates. These are photos saved with your notes.

english: Dates and captions come from your notes. Photos alone do not measure growth or prove a yield.
xhosa_before: Imihla neentetho zeefoto ziphuma kumanqaku akho. Iifoto zodwa azilinganisi ukukhula okanye ziqinisekise isivuno.
back_translation: Dates and captions come from your notes. Photos alone do not measure growth or confirm a harvest.
note: "okanye ziqinisekise" (subjunctive after a negative) is read as "or confirm"; negation holds. "Confirm" for "prove" is slightly soft.

english: Draft from your crop plan. Check what happened before saving. Today is selected; choose the day you actually did the work. This does not record a harvest quantity or mark the task complete.
xhosa_before: Uyilo olusuka kwisicwangciso sakho sezityalo. Khangela into eyenzekileyo ngaphambi kokugcina. Namhlanje ukhethiwe; khetha usuku owawenza ngalo umsebenzi. Oku akurekhodi bungakanani besivuno okanye kuphawule umsebenzi njengogqityiweyo.
back_translation: A design (or draft) from your crop plan. Check what happened before saving. Today is selected; choose the day you did the work. This does not record the size of the harvest or mark the task as finished.
xhosa_after: Idrafti esuka kwisicwangciso sakho sezityalo. Khangela into eyenzekileyo ngaphambi kokugcina. Namhlanje ukhethiwe; khetha usuku owawenza ngalo umsebenzi. Oku akurekhodi bungakanani besivuno okanye kuphawule umsebenzi njengogqityiweyo.
note: "Uyilo" is "design" everywhere else in the app (Saved design = Uyilo olugciniweyo). Read cold, the opening was "A design from your crop plan", losing that this is a draft entry the farmer must check before saving. Now "Idrafti" (the app word for draft). The rest of the caveat (no harvest quantity recorded, task not marked complete) was intact and is unchanged.

english: Saved copies (CSV and printable) are in English. Your notes keep their original language.
xhosa_before: Iikopi ezigciniweyo (i-CSV neyokushicilela) zikwisiNgesi. Amanqaku akho agcina ulwimi lwawo lokuqala.
back_translation: Saved copies (CSV and printable) are in English. Your notes keep their original language.

note: "indawo" is place/location; the English means measured area. Understandable.

english: Farmers with production or sales records
back_translation: Farmers with production or sales records

english: Farmers active in the last 90 days
back_translation: Farmers who worked in the last 90 days

xhosa_before: Akukho zinto zibonwe ngendawo ezabelwanayo ezifumanekayo
back_translation: No shared place observations are available

english: Based on recorded activity; this does not establish continued participation
xhosa_before: Kusekwe kumsebenzi orekhodiweyo; oku akuqinisekisi ukuqhubeka kokuthatha inxaxheba
back_translation: Based on recorded work; this does not confirm continuing participation

english: Vegetable beds + staple plots; physical area counted once
xhosa_before: Iibhedi zemifuno + amabala ezityalo eziyisiseko; indawo yokwenyani ibaliwe kanye kuphela
back_translation: Vegetable beds + staple crop fields; the real area is counted only once

xhosa_before: Amagadi awahlukeneyo angu-{n} · izinto ezibonwe ukususela ngomhla we-{first} ukuya kowe-{last}
back_translation: {n} different gardens · things observed from {first} to {last}

english: {n} of {m} visible farmer records include production
xhosa_before: Kwiirekhodi zabalimi ezibonakalayo ezi-{m}, {n} ziquka imveliso
back_translation: Of the {m} visible farmer records, {n} include production

english: {n} of {m} visible farmer records include sales
xhosa_before: Kwiirekhodi zabalimi ezibonakalayo ezi-{m}, {n} ziquka intengiso
back_translation: Of the {m} visible farmer records, {n} include sales

english: {n} of {m} visible farmer records include expenses
xhosa_before: Kwiirekhodi zabalimi ezibonakalayo ezi-{m}, {n} ziquka iindleko
back_translation: Of the {m} visible farmer records, {n} include costs

english: {n} visible farmer records; coverage is not total project reach
xhosa_before: Iirekhodi zabalimi ezibonakalayo ezingu-{n}; ukugubungela akuyonto yonke ifikelelwe yiprojekthi
back_translation: {n} visible farmer records; coverage is not everything the project has reached

english: Area figures use each garden’s latest observation. Farmer production and finances use available cumulative records, whose reporting periods and coverage may differ.
xhosa_before: Amanani endawo asebenzisa into ebonwe ngamva nje kwigadi nganye. Imveliso nemali yomlimi zisebenzisa iirekhodi ezidibeneyo ezikhoyo, ezinokwahluka ngamaxesha okubika nokugubungela.
back_translation: Place figures use the most recent observation in each garden. Production and farmer money use combined records that exist, which may differ in reporting periods and coverage.

english: Sales are revenue. Profit and R/m² require costs, production area and dates matched to the same activity; those ratios are not calculated here.
xhosa_before: Iintengiso yingeniso. Inzuzo ne-R/m² zifuna iindleko, indawo yokuvelisa kunye nemihla ehambelana nomsebenzi omnye; ezo ndlela zokuthelekisa azibaliswa apha.
back_translation: Sales are income. Profit and R/m² need costs, production area and dates matching one activity; those ways of comparing are not calculated here.

english: {n} enrolled farmers are withheld from the portfolio for consent.
xhosa_before: Abalimi abangu-{n} ababhalisiweyo abafakwanga kweli qela ngenxa yemvume.
back_translation: {n} registered farmers were not included in this group because of consent.
xhosa_after: Abalimi abangu-{n} ababhalisiweyo abafakwanga kweli qela ngenxa yokungabikho kwemvume.
note: "ngenxa yemvume" is "because of consent/permission", which does not say consent is missing; a farmer could read it as the reverse. Now "ngenxa yokungabikho kwemvume" (because consent is absent), so the withholding is explicit.

english: AI-generated example garden aerial. Not a satellite image or photograph of Ubhejane.
xhosa_before: Umzekelo wegadi ebukwa phezulu owenziwe yi-AI. Ayisosithombe se-satellite okanye ifoto ye-Ubhejane.
back_translation: An AI-made example garden viewed from above. It is not a satellite image or a photo of Ubhejane.

english: AI-generated example harvest. Not evidence of the real garden's production.
xhosa_before: Umzekelo wesivuno owenziwe yi-AI. Asingubungqina bemveliso yegadi yokwenyani.
back_translation: An AI-made example harvest. It is not evidence of the real garden's production.
